Hymn 113: Our Savior's Love
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Crawford Gates
Lyricist/Text Author: Edward L. Hart
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 113 titled "Our Savior's Love" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Crawford Gates and the lyrics were written by Edward L. Hart.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
